grid.unitDefinition: u = cap-height / 5; all geometry below is in u

rules: Orthogonal only: no curves, no radii, square terminals.
stroke = gap = 1u. This equality is the style.
A letter is built from segments, never from a stem with arms: the outer stems and the inner form are separate marks that happen to align.
The inner form is inset 1u from the cap line and stops 1u above the baseline, so the feet of a letter are its outer stems.
M and W are the only 5u-wide letters; every other letter box is 4u.
The tile is a first-class form: a square of 3 x cap-height, the mark centred, one cap-height of air on every side.
Never set the wordmark in live text: it ships as outlines.
Never place the mark on a gradient, a photo, or inside a container smaller than 16px.

assets.use: Primary mark, fill=currentColor. Inline HTML or CSS mask only — an has no CSS to inherit.
Self-contained tile on the ink plate: favicon, app icon, avatar, email.
Same tile on the paper plate, for light surfaces and print.
